name: K-QA
intro: K-QA 是一个来自 K Health 去标识化真实患者问题的英文长答案医学问答基准。BERT 与正则预筛得到约 26K 个候选问题，医疗专业人员最终选出来自 1,055 名用户、覆盖 172 种 ICD-10 病情的 1,212 个可独立回答问题。医生为其中 201 题编写参考答案并拆为 1,589 条必需/可选陈述；官方 GPT-4 少样本 NLI 据此计算全面性与幻觉率。原始患者对话语料未发布。
build_method: 自动预筛, 医生标注, GPT-4 辅助拆分
eval_feature: 真实世界, NLI 评测, 零样本
build_method_en: Automatic Prefiltering, Physician Annotation, GPT-4-assisted Decomposition
intro_en: K-QA is an English long-form medical QA benchmark built from deidentified real patient questions on K Health. BERT and regex prefiltering yield about 26K candidates; medical professionals retain 1,212 stand-alone questions from 1,055 users across 172 ICD-10 conditions. Physicians author references for 201 questions and decompose them into 1,589 Must Have or Nice to Have statements; the official GPT-4 few-shot NLI then computes comprehensiveness and hallucination scores. The raw patient-conversation corpus is not released.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.14493v1 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A–B plus official repository commit ef403d012e199fcfa0d8c02b38a96ff95164f4d0. The diagram distinguishes the 1,212-question set (1,055 users, 172 ICD-10 conditions) from the 201 physician-reference subset and preserves the ~26K candidate pool, six answer writers plus a reviewing physician, six different decomposition doctors, the 1,589 statements (892 Must Have, 697 Nice to Have), and the 6.86% GPT-4-suggestion edit rate. The official code checks Must-Have entailment and Must/Nice contradictions; full-benchmark Comp is the sum of per-question Must-Have entailment fractions divided by 201, while Hall is the total number of contradicted Must/Nice statements divided by 201, not a statement percentage. The 50-pair/402-statement/three-physician/Fleiss-kappa-0.70 study is an optional validator check, not a mandatory scoring stage. The public repository contains 1,212 questions, 201 answers and statements, and evaluation code, but its pinned NLI_medical_annotator.csv has 399 data rows versus the paper study's 402 statements; the raw patient-conversation corpus is not released.
